projects.title: Rainstorm
projects.description: A web-based ideation and writing tool that uses randomness and constraints to spark creativity.
projects.about: Rainstorm helps writers, musicians, and game designers move past the blank page. Inspired by roll-tables from tabletop RPGs like D&D, it combines random word generation with a drag-and-drop canvas to help you explore and organise ideas. Once you've gathered your words, switch to Define mode to add short notes and turn loose associations into a clear concept — then export as PDF, TXT, or copy to clipboard.
highlights: Two-mode workflow: Ideate (drag-and-drop canvas) and Define (structured text)
Drag-and-drop built with dnd-kit, animations with Framer Motion, audio with Howler.js
Fully keyboard accessible, following the European Accessibility Act (2025) guidelines
Projects saved locally via localStorage — no backend, no accounts, instant onboarding

projects.title: Papercut
projects.description: Revamped bookshop's WooCommerce store with improved search, filtering and checkout.
projects.about: Papercut is an independent bookshop in Stockholm. I was brought in to modernise their existing WordPress/WooCommerce site — overhauling the search experience, adding faceted filtering, and improving the overall design and checkout flow.
highlights: Built a custom WordPress plugin with React and GraphQL
Integrated Algolia for fast, faceted search and filtering
Improved checkout UX and overall site design

projects.title: Demokrati Uppropet
projects.description: Campaign site for a democratic manifesto — built and launched in two days.
projects.about: A one-page campaign site for Kristna Fredsrörelsen, gathering signatures and spreading a democratic manifesto ahead of Sweden's 2026 election. Built headless with Next.js, the site prioritises readability and reach — with Web Share API integration so visitors can easily spread the message across platforms.
highlights: Designed and built in two days to meet a tight campaign deadline
Web Share API integration to help visitors spread the manifesto
Clean, readable layout focused on content and message over aesthetics
